title: The MNI 152 templates of the human brain, from TemplateFlow: the ICBM 2009c nonlinear asymmetric average (the reference space of the EBRAINS atlas) at 1 mm, skull-stripped, with its brain mask and the whole head, and at 2 mm; and FSL's 6th-generation average at 2 mm
provider: TemplateFlow (Ciric, Markiewicz, Esteban et al.), serving the templates of the McConnell Brain Imaging Centre, Montreal Neurological Institute (Fonov et al. 2011) and of FSL
credit: Template: MNI 152 ICBM 2009c (Fonov et al. 2011), via TemplateFlow
format: NIfTI-1, gzipped, int16 T1-weighted intensities and uint8 masks, RAS with the sform and qform equal. MNI152NLin2009cAsym at 1 mm: 193 x 229 x 193 voxels, the first centred at (-96, -132, -78) mm; at 2 mm: 97 x 115 x 97 from (-96.5, -132.5, -78.5). MNI152NLin6Asym at 2 mm: 91 x 109 x 91 from (-90, -126, -72). The domain's neuroscience/js/nifti.js reads them; template_description.json lists every resolution's grid.
coverage: The whole head (T1w) or the brain (desc-brain), in MNI space
